physical_sources.tube: One OmniLight3D just beyond the diffuser; ceiling and wall spill from the mounted source.
physical_sources.surgical: One downward SpotLight3D just beneath each existing theatre lens.
physical_sources.warning: One wall-facing SpotLight3D just beyond each amber lens.
physical_sources.no_duplicate_light_pools: All 90 named legacy scene Light3D nodes removed before inserting the 56 prefab emitters.
physical_sources.service_contrast: Service and return-store tube energy retained at 0.82/0.85; brighter clinical work areas and stable exit/stair/cache landmarks.
physical_sources.geometry: New housings use code-native boxes/cylinders; existing lens/housing geometry is reused at 21 mounts. Fixture meshes cast no shadows. No physical bodies or collision shapes are introduced.

flicker.set_flicker_enabled: set_flicker_enabled(bool): immediately applies steady energy when false; enabling resumes the local deterministic phase.
flicker.reset: reset_lighting(): resets local phase to zero and immediately applies full energy.
flicker.inspection: lighting_state(): elapsed, enabled, damaged, factor, energy, lens_emission.
flicker.shape: Smooth cosine sag; no blackout, stochastic RNG, rapid flashes, timers or audio.
flicker.pause: PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE plus explicit tree.paused guard freezes phase, lens and emitter.
flicker.reset_ownership: Retry creates a fresh scene and zero phases; root may call reset_lighting on the group for any in-place reset path.
flicker.protected_landmarks: All stairs, controls, key access, caches and exits remain steady.

verification.native_scope: Cold scene collider equality after building authored stage polygons; physical lens/emitter alignment; deterministic waveform bounds; pause/reset/toggle; representative native room captures and wall-clock frame timing.
verification.runtime_scope: Independent Main fixture checks persisted display/light_flicker and Retry binding; root owns that evidence.
verification.limits: Offscreen automated frames at 640x360 are not human playtesting or a hardware performance guarantee. Forced draws include presentation overhead and can be refresh-limited. Full campaign combat and exported application acceptance belong to root release checks.
